operationalLimits.appliesTo: Emergency diesel engine gen-sets (Ref. Nos. 73 through 90)
operationalLimits.limitDetails: The permittee shall operate and maintain the emergency diesel engine gen-sets (Ref. Nos. 73 through 90) and control device according to the manufacturer's written instructions or procedures developed by the permittee that are approved by the engine manufacturer. In addition, the permittee may only change those settings that are permitted by the manufacturer and do not increase air emissions.

operationalLimits.appliesTo: Each emergency diesel engine gen-set (Ref. Nos. 73 through 90)
operationalLimits.limitDetails: No emergency diesel engine gen-set (Ref. Nos. 73 through 90) shall be operated for scheduled maintenance checks and readiness testing (Scheduled MCRT), stack testing, or operational training (that involves fuel combustion) between the hours of 7 a.m. to 5 p.m. any day during May 1 through September 30. Exceptions may be approved on a case-by-case basis by the Air Compliance Manager of DEQ's NRO.

operationalLimits.category: Ozone Season Operating Restrictions - Integration Operational Period
operationalLimits.appliesTo: Emergency diesel engine gen-set (Ref. Nos. 73 through 90)
operationalLimits.limitDetails: During the integration operational period, any operation of the unit (that involves fuel combustion) between the hours of 7 a.m. to 5 p.m. any day during the ozone season of May 1 through September 30 shall only occur if the forecast Air Quality Index (AQI) for ozone as published on the AirNow website (https://airnow.gov) for Northern Virginia for that day is less than or equal to 100. If an Air Alert is issued for Metropolitan Washington, D.C. for a day where forecasted AQI for ozone was less than or equal to 100, operation of each unit shall be minimized to the maximum extent practical.

operationalLimits.appliesTo: Emergency diesel engine gen-sets (Ref. Nos. 1 through 90 and T1 through T8)
operationalLimits.limitDetails: Shall only be operated in situations arising from sudden and reasonably unforeseeable events where the primary energy or power source is disrupted or disconnected (e.g., electrical grid failure, on-site disaster, public service emergencies), for participation in an ISO-declared emergency, for scheduled maintenance checks and readiness testing (Scheduled MCRT), for unscheduled maintenance, testing, and operational training, and for the integration operational period.

operationalLimits.appliesTo: No single emergency diesel engine gen-set (Ref. Nos. 1 through 72 and T1 through T8)
operationalLimits.limitDetails: Shall operate no more than 500 hours per year, calculated monthly as the sum of each consecutive 12-month period.

operationalLimits.appliesTo: Each emergency diesel engine gen-set (Ref. Nos. 73 through 89)
operationalLimits.limitDetails: Shall operate no more than 32 hours per year for scheduled maintenance checks and readiness testing (Scheduled MCRT).

operationalLimits.appliesTo: The emergency diesel engine gen-set (Ref. No. 90)
operationalLimits.limitDetails: Shall operate no more than 35 hours per year for scheduled maintenance checks and readiness testing (Scheduled MCRT).

operationalLimits.appliesTo: Each emergency diesel engine gen-set (Ref. Nos. 73 through 90)
operationalLimits.limitDetails: Shall operate no more than 500 hours per year for all purposes (as provided in Condition 6) combined. The annual limits for hours of operation shall be calculated monthly as the sum of each consecutive 12-month period.

operationalLimits.appliesTo: Diesel engine gen-sets (Ref. Nos. 1 through 90 and T1 through T8)
operationalLimits.limitDetails: Approved fuel is diesel fuel oil, defined as ultra-low sulfur diesel fuel oil (ULSD), renewable diesel, or a blend of these fuels. Must meet ASTM D975 for grade ultra low sulfur 1-D S15 or grade 2-D S15, or have a maximum sulfur content not to exceed 0.0015% by weight (15 ppm), and either a minimum cetane number of forty or maximum aromatic content of thirty-five volume percent.

operationalLimits.appliesTo: Emergency diesel engine gen-sets (Ref. Nos. 1 through 90) combined
operationalLimits.limitDetails: Shall consume no more than 690,702 gallons of diesel fuel oil per year, calculated daily as the sum of each consecutive 365-day period.

operationalLimits.appliesTo: Eight (8) emergency diesel engine gen-sets (Ref. Nos. T1 through T8) combined
operationalLimits.limitDetails: Shall consume no more than 20,460 gallons of diesel fuel oil per year, calculated daily as the sum of each consecutive 365-day period (all uses).
